deploy-bot: [AUTO] Promotion blocked for release inference-ingress: chart version mismatch detected. Canary chart v2.7.0 vs staging chart v2.8.0. Change window active (EU-west 14:00-16:00). Action required: pin staging to v2.7.0 or rollforward canary/staging.

maria: pinging eng-release crew — what's the breaking delta in 2.8.0?

zack: 2.8.0 changes ingress rewrite behavior. New values key `ingress.basePath` introduced; default in 2.8.0 is '/v1' for some overlays. Canary currently relies on '/' so routing would 404 clients. No DB migrations.

anya: confirmed with helm diff:
```
- ingress:
-   basePath: /
+ ingress:
+   basePath: /v1
```
This will change exposed paths.

lucas: If we pin staging to 2.7.0 we avoid immediate risk. Rollback should not touch images. Need to ensure any promoted images are compatible; looks fine.

kim: product preference: rollforward asap if it's safe — 2.8.0 fixes TLS renegotiation for internal LB. But small routing break is bad for external integrators.

maria: proposal: try a quick values patch in canary to match staging basePath and rerun health + smoke. If green, allow promotion. Else pin staging to 2.7.0 and schedule 2.8.1 with migration note. Consensus?

zack: I can patch canary right now:
```bash
helm upgrade inference-ingress ./charts/inference \
  --namespace canary \
  --reuse-values \
  --set ingress.basePath=/v1 \
  --wait --timeout 5m
```
This keeps chart v2.7.0 but aligns values to staging.

deploy-bot: queued job `canary-values-patch-1742103500` by zack. Running health checks (15m window). Logs: https://ci/release/1742103500

maria: smoke plan: hit /health and /v1/predict with 50 qps for 2m, validate 2xx and payload schema.

lucas: monitoring thresholds set: P50 < 150ms, error rate < 0.5%. Alert if breached, we'll abort promotion.

anya: I'll prepare release notes fragment: "ingress.basePath default changed in 2.8.0 — if you rely on root path, set ingress.basePath to '/' in values." Add migration steps.

kim: add customer-facing note: "no action needed for most customers; integration owners using custom paths should review."

maria: quick decision tree: patch canary -> run smoke -> if green, allow promotion; if not, pin staging to 2.7.0 and open 2.8.1 rollback/compatibility issue.

deploy-bot: canary patch completed at 1742103605, health checks: passed. Canary run id=cb-1742103605.

zack: promoting canary to staging now (promotion id pr-1742103612). Will update release notes and changelog.

lucas: watching logs — no 404 spike observed after patch. Latency stable.

maria: consensus reached. Staging pinned? no, proceeding to rollforward. I'll mark release notes: "2.8.0 includes LB TLS fix; default ingress.basePath now '/v1' for new overlays — if you depend on '/', set ingress.basePath: '/'."

kim: flagged for outreach to top 3 integrators, FYI.

deploy-bot: promotion completed at 1742103718. Final status: SUCCESS. Attach deploy run: https://ci/release/1742103612/logs. If any regressions, reopen thread and/or request pin with label `release-pin`.
